name: launchpad
description: Launchpad MCP server (issues, comments, documents, attachments) and a skill for agents

url.title: Launchpad URL
url.description: Address of your Launchpad server, for example https://launchpad.example.com

org.title: Organisation slug
org.description: The slug of your organisation, for example acme

token.title: Agent token
token.description: A Launchpad agent token (it starts with odt_). Make it in Settings, Agents. It is kept in your system credential store.

team.title: Default team key
team.description: Optional. The key of the team new issues go to, for example ACME

files_url.title: Files URL
files_url.description: Optional. The address of your files host, for example https://launchpad-files.example.com. Needed for download_attachment.
